01

Why are LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms more effective than external landing pages?

+
Auto-Fill Verified Corporate Data

LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms auto-populate with the user's verified corporate email, job title, and company name directly from their profile. This eliminates mobile typing friction and delivers 2x higher completion rates.

The Decision Deploy native LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms with instant CRM webhook sync.
  1. Lead Gen Form Setup
  2. Field Mapping & Privacy Terms
  3. Direct CRM Webhook Dispatch
02

How do you keep cost-per-lead affordable on LinkedIn?

+
Precision Audience Layering & Exclusions

LinkedIn advertising is expensive if targeted broadly. We layer job function, seniority (Director+), and company headcount, while excluding entry-level roles and irrelevant industries.

The Decision Strict negative audience exclusions and tight budget capping.
  1. Audience Layering
  2. Negative Exclusions
  3. Bid Capping Optimization
03

Can LinkedIn ads support founder thought leadership?

+
Thought Leader Ad Formats

Yes. Sponsoring executive posts directly from your CEO or founder's personal profile generates 3x higher engagement and trust compared to standard corporate brand page ads.

The Decision Amplify founder thought leadership posts targeting key enterprise accounts.
  1. Executive Content Strategy
  2. Thought Leader Ad Setup
  3. Engagement Follow-Up
04

Do you integrate with sales automation and outreach workflows?

+
Omnichannel ABM Retargeting

We coordinate LinkedIn advertising with cold email outreach and sales team follow-ups so prospects see your brand across multiple professional touchpoints.

The Decision Align ad flight schedules with active sales development outreach.
  1. Target Account List Match

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything business owners and growth leaders need to know before initiating a sprint with Inrank Technologies.

What is the minimum budget for LinkedIn advertising?+

We typically recommend a minimum ad spend of ₹25,000 to ₹50,000/month for LinkedIn B2B campaigns due to higher platform CPMs.

What type of content performs best on LinkedIn Ads?+

Downloadable industry research, customer case studies, and executive problem-solving guides generate the highest conversion rates.

Can we target specific companies by name?+

Yes. LinkedIn allows us to upload an exact list of target companies (Account-Based Marketing) and deliver ads only to their leadership.

How quickly do leads arrive?+

Leads begin flowing within 24 to 48 hours of campaign launch and are instantly forwarded to your sales team.

What does Inrank charge for LinkedIn Ads management?+

Our B2B LinkedIn Ads sprint management is priced at ₹14,999/month on a transparent flat fee.
